title: Connected random-relation collector
objective: Connect the authenticated PARI 2.17.4 random-relation scheduler to exact R*P[j] ideal construction, RND_REL_RELPID insertion, and resident HNF append on a frozen field-3 branch

handoff.summary: Closed the frozen field-3 random-relation corridor from authenticated rnd_rel scheduling through exact R*P[j] construction, Fincke_Pohst_ideal/RND_REL_RELPID insertion, log append, and resident hnfadd. CPython, JavaScript, and GMP reproduce PARI's RNG endpoint, two relation rows, generators, provenance, serialized logs, and full H/D/B/C/permutation state.
risks: The control deliberately forces the first post-HNF collection through literal rnd_rel; this is a frozen branch witness, not a complete outer scheduling loop.
Tagged exact arithmetic is inapplicable because the authenticated log and HNF owners contain 256-320-bit integers.
next_steps: Integrate the corridor behind the shared prepared/resumable driver after review.
Port repeated random attempts, duplicate-pressure behavior, later subfactor changes, and factor-base enlargement.
